A newcomer can follow snapshot → read latest → merge+write from the numbers plus the notes. But small text and broken labels slow this down, and who sends the signals needs explaining.

coldRead: crumb runs a detached Node supervisor for each state-mode session, and the supervisor owns a Playwright Chrome context. Every --autosave seconds (default 30), on SIGUSR2, or on SIGINT/SIGTERM as a final save, the supervisor takes a snapshot of Chrome's cookies and storage (1). It then reads the latest encrypted session for the account from the vault (2), three-way merges latest/before/after, and writes the result atomically to a 0600 temp file, then renames it into place (3). Saves that overlap are combined into one, and unchanged snapshots are skipped. Errors are only logged. If Chrome closes by itself, the supervisor exits without a final save. The vault key comes from CRUMB_KEY, the OS keychain, or a key file. There is no lock against other writers.
inaccuracies: Each successful save also updates the run handle's autosave.lastSavedAt (src/session.ts:209), which `crumb sync` polls (src/session.ts:266-272). The 'Outside this view' note excludes run handle files, but leaving them out hides the signal/acknowledgement loop.
Who sends SIGUSR2/SIGTERM is not shown. In practice the CLI's sync and close commands send them (src/session.ts:254, 267), so the 'Save triggers' note looks like a purely internal trigger.
The edge labels 'merge→temp+rena me' and 'snapshot→cookies/s tore' are wrapped mid-token, so the visible text is garbled even though the facts are right.
improvements: Scale the diagram to fill the 1194x834 viewport and raise the font size of edge labels and notes to at least 12px. Widen the edge label boxes so tokens don't break mid-word.

Draw the triggers explicitly: a timer element and an external 'crumb CLI (sync/close)' actor sending SIGUSR2/SIGTERM, styled as separately initiated events. Optionally add the handle `lastSavedAt` write as the acknowledgement path.

Attach failure markers to the elements they affect (Chrome closing on its own → no final save; write → no lock; save error → only logged). Show the key provider as an external dependency of the vault.
